blind.description: A stylized fantasy wooden executioner's block set on a low square wooden platform. The platform consists of wood planks bounded by corner posts with metal pyramidal studs. Atop the platform is a heavy wooden block banded with metal straps, featuring a carved neck indentation, and a large executioner's axe embedded firmly into the top of the block with its handle angled upward. Next to the block sits a woven wicker basket for catching heads. Surfaces are completely solid, continuous, and stylized with hand-painted textures; no hovering geometry or disconnected shards.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it presents a roughly square wooden planked platform with corner posts, a rectangular chopping block in the center with an axe handle pointing straight towards the bottom edge, and a circular wicker basket resting to the lower-left.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: a raised square wooden platform with corner feet
blind.height_vs_figure: The entire assembly (to the tip of the axe handle) reaches about one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2 ft tall), and the square platform is roughly 3 ft wide by 3 ft deep.
